review_scope: SOC SPA contracts, same-origin generated API client, bounded server state and SSE, fixed information architecture, governance/target/model/plugin workflows, three-layer rule evidence, eight-kind plugin statistics renderer, accessibility, performance, static OCI and browser evidence

findings.title: The ninth required Web module did not exist
findings.resolution: Implemented an independent Vue 3/Vite SOC SPA with the frozen task-oriented information architecture, same-origin public boundary, project design tokens, static non-root OCI delivery and no Node/BFF runtime.

findings.title: Overview had no bounded same-response server snapshot contract
findings.resolution: Added GET /api/dashboard and a strict eight-item-per-section contract produced by one PostgreSQL statement snapshot; the browser no longer assembles independently timed Overview requests.

findings.title: The Web projection schema rejected actual list envelopes and omitted active resource kinds
findings.resolution: Aligned optional resource identity, first-page cursor, multi-scope strings, trace bounds and the complete closed resource-kind list while retaining unknown-major/kind rejection.

findings.title: Rule Effectiveness API collapsed installation, match and outcome context
findings.resolution: Extended the safe projection with exact installation/readback, direct and eligible deltas, quality/reset semantics and independent expected/actual outcome; the UI presents three explicit stages and never infers outcome from counters.

findings.title: Closed narrow-screen navigation remained in the accessibility focus tree
findings.resolution: Synchronized responsive navigation with inert, aria-hidden, aria-expanded and aria-controls; added Escape closure and a 44px menu target while preserving desktop navigation semantics.

findings.title: Web lacked immutable non-root static OCI and same-origin proxy policy
findings.resolution: Added digest-pinned Node build and NGINX unprivileged runtime stages, content-hashed assets, no source maps, inherited CSP/security headers, immutable asset cache, no-store shell/API/SSE and non-root UID 101 runtime.

findings.title: Recent alerts table caused document-level overflow at 320 CSS pixels
findings.resolution: Placed the intrinsic-width alert table in a named, keyboard-focusable horizontal scroll region while keeping the document at the 320 CSS pixel viewport; Chromium, Firefox and WebKit now verify reflow, keyboard navigation and reduced motion.

findings.title: Target registration UI allowed a credential and TLS identity mismatch rejected by Go
findings.resolution: Added fail-closed client validation that p4runtime_tls.identity_ref exactly equals credential_ref, matching the Go target contract; the real P9 runner now supplies and verifies one exact identity.

findings.title: Managed Targets omitted endpoint, assignment, readback freshness and profile drift facts
findings.resolution: Expanded the bounded scoped Go projection with display/endpoint, latest assignment and lease, desired-versus-observed profile alignment, P4Info/application generation, connection/mastership freshness and latest lifecycle audit. Web now shows the summary columns and keeps the nested facts in its drawer.
